name: menuPass – APT Threat Map
description: Técnicas de menuPass com cobertura do catálogo (score 3=regra, 2=parcial, 1=lacuna)

techniques.comment: menuPass has used a modified version of pentesting tools wmiexec.vbs and secretsdump.py to dump credentials. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used Ntdsutil to dump credentials. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used a modified version of pentesting tools wmiexec.vbs and secretsdump.py to dump credentials. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has collected various files from the compromised computers. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used several tools to scan for open NetBIOS nameservers and enumerate NetBIOS sessions. | cobertura: regra

menuPass uses scripts to enumerate IP ranges on the victim network. menuPass has also issued the command `net view /domain` to a PlugX implant to gather information about remote systems on the network. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used RDP connections to move across the victim network. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used Putty Secure Copy Client (PSCP) to transfer data. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has encoded strings in its malware with base64 as well as with a simple, single-byte XOR obfuscation using key 0x40. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used esentutl to change file extensions to their true type that were masquerading as .txt files. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has renamed certutil and moved it to a different location on the system to avoid detection based on use of the tool. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has been seen changing malicious files to appear legitimate. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has collected data from remote systems by mounting network shares with `net use` and using Robocopy to transfer data. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used tcping.exe, similar to Ping, to probe port status on systems of interest. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used a modified version of pentesting script wmiexec.vbs, which logs into a remote machine using WMI. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used `net use` to conduct connectivity checks to machines. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used a script (atexec.py) to execute a command on a target machine via Task Scheduler. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used process hollowing in iexplore.exe to load the RedLeaves implant. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used key loggers to steal usernames and passwords. | cobertura: regra
menuPass uses PowerSploit to inject shellcode into PowerShell. | cobertura: regra

menuPass executes commands using a command-line interface and reverse shell. The group has used a modified version of pentesting script wmiexec.vbs to execute commands. menuPass has used malicious macros embedded inside Office documents to execute files. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used Wevtutil to remove PowerShell execution logs. | cobertura: regra
A menuPass macro deletes files after it has decoded and decompressed them. | cobertura: regra
menuPass stages data prior to exfiltration in multi-part archives, often saved in the Recycle Bin. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has staged data on remote MSP systems or other victim networks prior to exfiltration. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used valid accounts including shared between Managed Service Providers and clients to move between the two environments. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has searched compromised systems for folders of interest including those related to HR, audit and expense, and meeting memos. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used the Microsoft administration tool csvde.exe to export Active Directory data. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used a global service provider's IP as a proxy for C2 traffic from a victim. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has installed updates and new malware on victims. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used native APIs including `GetModuleFileName`, `lstrcat`, `CreateFile`, and `ReadFile`. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used the Csvde tool to collect Active Directory files and data. | cobertura: regra

menuPass has used certutil in a macro to decode base64-encoded content contained in a dropper document attached to an email. The group has also used `certutil -decode` to decode files on the victim’s machine when dropping UPPERCUT. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has leveraged vulnerabilities in Pulse Secure VPNs to hijack sessions. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used legitimate access granted to Managed Service Providers in order to access victims of interest. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has attempted to get victims to open malicious files such as Windows Shortcuts (.lnk) and/or Microsoft Office documents, sent via email as part of spearphishing campaigns. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used tools to exploit the ZeroLogon vulnerability (CVE-2020-1472). | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used `InstallUtil.exe` to execute malicious software. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has resized and added data to the certificate table to enable the signing of modified files with legitimate signatures. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has encrypted files and information before exfiltration. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has compressed files before exfiltration using TAR and RAR. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has sent malicious Office documents via email as part of spearphishing campaigns as well as executables disguised as documents. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used dynamic DNS service providers to host malicious domains. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has used DLL side-loading to launch versions of Mimikatz and PwDump6 as well as UPPERCUT. menuPass has also used DLL search order hijacking. | cobertura: regra
menuPass has registered malicious domains for use in intrusion campaigns. | cobertura: lacuna
menuPass has used and modified open-source tools like Impacket, Mimikatz, and pwdump. | cobertura: regra
